scope: SQLite 3.53.4 connection last-insert-rowid on the production Core rollback and WAL paths; not a full SQL or file-format compatibility claim.

trusted: Lean elaborator, compiler, runtime and platform C toolchain
IO.FS file operations, fsync, rename and directory locks
Std.Mutex and task scheduling for the serialized connection
the operating system and filesystem page-write behaviour

popl_parity.status: parity, derived in the opposite direction

negative_results_preserved: 14/84 failed in the first implementation due to empty output rows from internal RETURNING evaluation.
Two external-source INSERT SELECT tests exposed eager register binding; the final suite includes those cases and streaming predicate, limit, conflict and AUTOINCREMENT variants.

The first final live audit failed because it still looked for the old direct RETURNING binding call. The audit now checks both calls in the new binding chain; only this audit was rerun after its script correction.
limitations: The 88 survey cases are a feature sample, not a compatibility percentage.
Register-dependent external INSERT SELECT currently admits plain single-source scans; sorted, grouped, distinct and compound plans remain outside that streaming executor.
Failed statements with a successful insertion prefix, trigger-local register restoration, virtual-table writes and WITHOUT ROWID require further work.
Static pretranslated write theorems now explicitly require no connection-register reads; dynamic inserts use the checked RETURNING executor and new register-binding/state-preservation theorems.
